question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Lie low

options.text: Lie down and relax after a tiring day
Fly a plane at a low altitude

solution:
The correct answer is **'Try not to be noticed'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given **idiom 'Lie low' **is** 'Try not to be noticed'.**
 
• **Lie low: **to try not to attract attention to yourself. [चुपचाप रहना (कि आप पर ध्यान न जाए)]
 
 
• *Example: We'll have to **lie low **until tonight.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Try not to be noticed.*
